contact.name: Brittany Loewen
contact.evidence_quote: Brittany Loewen is the Nutrient Maximizer Sales Leader. You may recognize her name because she has extensive experience working with retailers. Before she entered this new role, Loewen was the U.S. Crop Protection Retail Channel Leader for Corteva. Some of her other past titles include territory manager and nitrogen sales specialist. In all, she has worked in the agriculture industry for 14 years.

contacts.rung: Other role. Brittany Loewen is a named leader at Corteva Agriscience responsible for sales and retailer relationships.
